name: swift-mutation-testing
note: Fixtures are test data. SandboxCleaner and SandboxName are left out because this repository's own tests call removeOrphaned() on the real sandbox directory: a mutant of the owner-is-alive check, run by those tests inside the sandbox, deletes the sandboxes of the run that is measuring it. The timeout is 300 s because a mutant that survives its tests runs the whole suite, which takes well over the default 30 s under fifteen workers; the suites that run the pipeline themselves are skipped inside a mutant's run by the notInsideAMutationRun trait.
